subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these fourteen pinned upstream action revisions for workflows that handle app private keys, registry credentials, and OpenAI API keys?
rationale: The patch does not widen OpenClaw workflow permissions or unpin actions, but accepting changed third-party action code in privileged workflows is a repository trust decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Approve after supplier review
options.body: Accept the immutable revision updates after the CI/security workflow owner reviews the upstream release changes and the refreshed required checks pass.

options.title: Split sensitive action upgrades
options.body: Pause this batch and separate the app-token, Docker, and Codex action changes if the owners want narrower trust-review units.

recommendation.title: Approve after supplier review
recommendation.body: Accept the immutable revision updates after the CI/security workflow owner reviews the upstream release changes and the refreshed required checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable human workflow owner was established from the available history/context, so this needs normal CI/security ownership routing.
